verdict.rationale: Fireflies offers automation-adjacent features (auto-join calendar meetings, rules engine for admin workflows, API/MCP access) but there's no evidence of user-configurable autonomous agentic automations that run in the background beyond meeting recording/transcription triggers. missing for 10: documented workflow/automation builder for arbitrary recurring agentic tasks, evidence of scheduled/triggered actions beyond meeting auto-join, independent confirmation of autonomous multi-step automation execution.
